f7469b.title: Recon: :4175 is an empty static skeleton (SimpleHTTP directory listing)
f7469b.content:
Target http://host.docker.internal:4175 is a **Python http.server (SimpleHTTP/0.6, Python 3.9.6)** static file server with directory listing enabled. It serves a PRUNED project skeleton of a Next.js "master chatbot template" (barber/restaurant/spa). **Zero files are served** — all dirs (root, api/, assets/, docs/, templates/, tests/, node_modules/, test-results/) return empty listings. `node_modules/` has 63 top-level packages but all subdirs are empty (no package.json files; .bin symlinks are broken/404).

Stack inferred from dir names: stripe, resend, @upstash/redis, @sentry/*, standardwebhooks, playwright, jsdom, undici, postal-mime. Test artifact names leak API semantics: "api-contract ... list SIN token → 401" (token-auth API in the real app), "restaurant-booking-audit ES-16/17", interface tests in Spanish.

No dynamic endpoints, no forms, no cookies, no auth on :4175. Only GET/HEAD; OPTIONS/TRACE/PUT → 501. Traversal probes blocked (404). No robots.txt/.git/.env/package.json anywhere (verified 404 + ffuf + katana).

Full inventory: /workspace/recon/endpoints.txt and /workspace/recon/notes.md. All recon traffic is in the Caido proxy. Recommended: do NOT spend cycles fuzzing :4175 for dynamic bugs — the only live finding class here is the exposed directory structure/info disclosure. Deeper app testing would need the actual app instance (token-auth API, Stripe webhooks, chatbot flows) which is not reachable on this port.
